wiki.text:
thumb|right|Mudshell
thumb|right|Mudshell, interior
Mudshell, an elder cray, is making this area unsafe for all! Head in and defeat Mudshell!

Mudshell is a difficulty 5 battle that is started by clicking on Mudshell in Blackspore. He is found in the north end of the region, near the shoreline and also in the Sinking Graveyard. After accepting a battle with Mudshell he disappears for an unknown duration of time.

 Required 

Level 13, Any Combat Job

 Goals 

Defeat Mudshell.

 Rewards 

14 Stars
Members Only Bonus: 95 Coins
